name: agentdust
description: Explain AgentDust reports, setup and port recovery.

interface.shortDescription: Guide cleanup, local port recovery and setup
interface.longDescription: Explain AgentDust process and disk reports, guide client setup and help an agent recover a requested local server start after EADDRINUSE. This package contains guidance only and does not provide live process access. Port diagnosis and recovery require access to local AgentDust tools through the CLI or a separately configured MCP connection. Automatic cleanup requires an existing user-authorized directory policy; uncertain cleanup needs typed approval. Setup does not enable directory scopes.
defaultPrompt: Help me understand this AgentDust disk report:
How do I set up AgentDust locally?
My server start failed with EADDRINUSE. Help me recover using AgentDust.

publication.release_notes: Adds agent-guided server-start recovery with AgentDust's existing directory policy, fresh port checks after approval, and a single retry. Adds client setup readiness guidance. This package contains skills only; live process and port inspection needs local CLI access or a separate MCP connection.
